Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: prop reference sheet for a public GitHub project, used as a binding reference for every later frame of the project
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes every recurring object of the project so it is reproduced identically in later scenes — same folder, same sheet of paper, same marble plaque, same blue thread, same glass plate, same marble seat.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 shows the closed gold folder exactly as it must look in every later frame — copy that folder's shape, proportions, flap, rounded corners and matte muted-gold finish precisely.
Subject: seven isolated objects laid out as a museum reference plate on a warm ivory ground, each object alone, none touching another, all lit identically.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, two rows. Upper row, left to right: the closed muted-gold client folder seen at a slight three-quarter angle exactly as in Image 3; the same folder again with a single blank white sheet half drawn out of it; one blank white sheet of paper lying flat; one blank white marble plaque, a plain rectangle with a flat empty face raised slightly above the surface with a soft shadow. Lower row, left to right: a single thin sky-blue thread running horizontally and ending in a small blue arrowhead; a frosted glass plate lying flat, clear and empty; a small classical white-marble seat with a low back, seen at a three-quarter angle. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the objects. Even spacing, generous empty ivory space around every object, nothing overlapping, nothing cropped by the frame.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D product render, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, white marble, frosted glass, matte muted gold, physically plausible materials, museum reference plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident, identical lighting on every object
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, sky blue #B8D6EA for the thread and arrowhead only, muted gold #C9A87A for the folder only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints: preserve the reference style; preserve a recognizable classical column; the folder must match Image 3 exactly in shape and finish; every paper sheet and every plaque face is completely blank and flat; the marble plaque face is smooth enough to carry a caption later; highest final quality; maximum resolution
Avoid: dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, shiny mirror gold, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, human figures, hands, deity, owl, scales, sword, engraved ornament on the plaque or the sheets, callout lines
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no labels, no measurement marks anywhere in the image.
